paper.title: Interaction-Induced Symmetry Breaking in Circular Quantum Dots
paper.authors: Andres Perez Fadon, Gino Cassella, Halvard Sutterud, W. M. C. Foulkes

results.system_description: 2D quantum dot: 2 electrons (1 up, 1 down) in a harmonic trap, omega = 0.5 (Hartree units), Coulomb repulsion
